scholarships.title: MEXT Scholarship for 2027 - Embassy Recommendation (Research Students)
scholarships.funding_label: Fully funded government scholarship (tuition + stipend + airfare + insurance)
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan

existing.description: The MEXT Scholarship Embassy Recommendation for Research Students is the Japanese government scholarship route in which candidates apply through their national Japanese embassy or consulate general, which conducts the first screening, and are then selected by MEXT to undertake research at a Japanese host institution. For the 2027 cycle, recruitment of students arriving in April 2027 or September/October 2027 is conducted between April and May of the previous year, with first screening by the embassies between May and July. Applicants must submit the application forms, a certificate of health and a recommendation letter to their own Japanese embassy or consulate general, and must not send documents directly to MEXT.
eligibility: Apply through the Embassy Recommendation procedure via the Japanese embassy or consulate general in your country of nationality
Meet the academic and age requirements published by your own embassy or consulate general, which vary by country
Undertake research at a Japanese host institution as a Research Student
Submit the required forms, a certificate of health and a recommendation letter to the embassy or consulate
existing.eligibility_summary: Candidates nominated through their national Japanese embassy or consulate general under the Embassy Recommendation procedure, applying to undertake research in Japan as a Research Student. Country-specific age, academic and language requirements are set by each mission, which publishes its own schedule.
requirements: Applications must go through the Japanese embassy or consulate general; MEXT must not be contacted directly
The Certificate of Health must be completed by a professional medical doctor
The country-specific application process and schedule differ by nationality and must be confirmed with the relevant mission
Candidates should consult the published Application Guidelines for Research Students
documents: Placement Preference Application Form for FY2027 (official PDF)
Field of Study and Research Plan (official PDF)
Certificate of Health, filled in by a professional medical doctor (official PDF)
Recommendation Letter, in any form or style (official sample PDF)
Additional documents required by your own embassy or consulate general
application_method: Read the Application Guidelines for Research Students and follow the instructions
Complete the FY2027 Application Form, Placement Preference Form, Field of Study and Research Plan, Certificate of Health and Recommendation Letter
Submit these documents to the Japanese embassy or consulate general in your country
Do not send any application documents directly to MEXT
Wait for embassy first screening (May to July) and subsequent MEXT selection
Inquire with your own embassy or consulate general for the country-specific schedule
existing.selection_notes: Two-stage selection: first screening between May and July by the Japanese embassies or consulates general, then selection by MEXT. Country-specific schedules apply.
existing.best_fit: International research students who can apply through their national Japanese embassy or consulate general within the April-to-May recruitment window for the relevant intake year.
existing.duration: 1-2 years (Research Student non-regular phase); standard period of intended Master's/Ph.D. course thereafter. Total up to 5 years. Scholarship period ends March 2029 for 2027 intake.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle tied to arrival: recruitment April to May of the previous year, embassy first screening May to July, arrival in Japan in April or September/October. Country-specific schedules are set by each Japanese embassy or consulate general.
existing.deadline_display: Recruitment for the 2027 intake (arrival April 2027 or September/October 2027) was made between April and May 2026, with embassy screening between May and July 2026. The next intake follows the same annual April-to-May window.
existing.program_type: Government scholarship (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
